title: Woman Goes Completely NUTS After Flashing Her Breasts To Store Owner
description:
#news #police #arrest

On January 7th, 2023. Officers were dispatched to a foot massage store after the store owner called for a woman who was acting disorderly. The store owner said she came in and took off her pants and top trying to get a happy ending massage. The woman did not speak any english and when asked for ID she only gave her foreign passport. Her name was Maria.
